segments.tha-ap275:1.3: Paccuggantvāna katvāna [paccuggantvāna’ kāsahaṃ (aṭṭha.), paccuggamanaṃ katvāna (?)], caṅkoṭaka [caṅgoṭaka (sī.)] madāsahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap275:5.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā caṅkoṭakiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.

lines: Tatiyāpadāne mahāsamuddaṃ nissāyāti mahāsāgarāsanne ṭhitassa pabbatassa antare pabbataleṇeti attho.
Paccuggantvānakāsahanti ahaṃ tassa bhagavato paṭiuggantvā samīpaṃ gantvā vandanādipuññaṃ akāsinti attho.
Caṅkoṭakamadāsahanti siddhatthassa bhagavato ahaṃ pupphabharitaṃ caṅkoṭakaṃ kadambaṃ adāsiṃ pūjesinti attho.
